dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 大夫说是感冒，我应该多休息，多喝水。
dialogue.reading: Dàifu shuō shì gǎnmào, wǒ yīnggāi duō xiūxi, duō hē shuǐ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Duì. Nǐ yě yīnggāi duō chī shuǐguǒ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 我每天都吃水果。我很注意健康！
dialogue.reading: Wǒ měitiān dōu chī shuǐguǒ. Wǒ hěn zhùyì jiànkāng!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 可是你每天晚上十二点睡觉，太晚了！
dialogue.reading: Kěshì nǐ měitiān wǎnshang shí'èr diǎn shuìjiào, tài wǎn le!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Hǎo, yǐhòu wǒ shí diǎn shuìjiào.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 还有，你应该多穿衣服。外面风很大，小心！
dialogue.reading: Hái yǒu, nǐ yīnggāi duō chuān yīfu. Wàimiàn fēng hěn dà, xiǎoxīn!
